items.title: Binance Begins Reopening Withdrawals With Bitcoin After $6.3 Billion Hack
items.summary: The exchange says it has replenished about 95% of the impacted amount, with less-liquid tokens accounting for the remaining 5%.

items.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
items.summary: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

items.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
items.summary: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

items.title: Hackers hijack a dozen DeFi websites, all registered with Name.com, and steal about $138,000
items.summary: All 12 hijacked domains are registered through Name.com, according to registry records accessed by The Block, suggesting a compromise.
